review_notes.hook_claim: L21-p1: initial contact at the promoter; proteins open the promoter; RNA polymerase reads the template strand.
review_notes.analogy: A train leaving the station on one track.

scenes.title: Recap: how transcription starts
scenes.narration: Quick recap. Step one: RNA polymerase makes contact at the promoter. Step two: proteins open up the DNA there. Step three: polymerase reads the template strand and builds matching RNA. The coding strand is not read. Like a train leaving the station on one track. RNA polymerase starts at the promoter and reads the template strand. Let's see what you remember.
